title: Aeonglass

moves.title: Increasing Intensity
effects: Upgrade all Wither cards in player's deck

move_pattern: Cycles through Ebb → Eye Lasers → Increasing Intensity
notes: Aeonglass gains Strength progressively with each Increasing Intensity move, starting at 3/4 Strength and increasing by 1 each subsequent use. Each use of Increasing Intensity also upgrades all existing Wither cards in the player's deck, scaling up their effects. Withering Presence is applied to all opponents at game start (6 stacks), and Artifact Power is applied to Aeonglass itself (3 stacks).
